name: Daily Care Toothpaste
shortDescription: A balanced, naturally-flavoured daily paste for healthy enamel, gums, and breath.
description: The essential paste — engineered to do the everyday job exceptionally well. A balanced fluoride formula that fights plaque, supports gum health, and freshens breath without the harsh chemicals, sulphates, or synthetic dyes you don't need. Clean ingredients, clean teeth, clean conscience.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to a soft-bristled brush.
Brush gently for two minutes, twice daily.
Pair with flossing for the complete daily routine.
